Another may reap what
in springtime I've planted,
Another rejoice in the fruit of my pain,
Not knowing my tears when
in summer I fainted
While toiling sad-hearted
in the sunshine and rain.

4
The thorns will have choked and the
summers suns blasted
The most of the seed which
in springtime I've sown;
But the Lord who has watched
while my weary toil lasted
Will give me a harvest for what I have done.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

titleEn: JESUS, MY LORD, TO THEE I CRY
lyricsEn:
1
Jesus, my Lord, to Thee I cry;
Unless Thou save me, I must die:
Oh, bring Thy free salvation nigh,
And take me as I am!
And take me as I am! (X2)
My only plea—Christ died for me!
Oh, take me as I am!

2
Helpless I am, and full of guilt;
But yet for me Thy blood was spilt,
And Thou canst make me what Thou wilt,
And take me as I am.

3
No preparation can I make,
My best resolves I only break,
Yet save me for Thine own Name's sake,
And take me as I am.

4
Behold me, Savior, at Thy feet,
Deal with me as Thou seest meet;
Thy work begin, Thy work complete,
But take me as I am.
lyricsFr:
1
Jésus est au milieu de nous,
Son regard s'abaisse sur nous,
Sa douce voix l'entendez-vous ?
« Je veux vous bénir tous » (X 2)
Sa douce voix l'entendez-vous ?
« Je veux vous bénir tous ! »

2
Jésus est au milieu de nous,
Son regard s'abaisse sur nous,
Sa douce voix l'entendez-vous ?
« Je veux vous sauver tous ! » (X 2)
Sa douce voix l'entendez-vous ?
« Je veux vous sauver tous ! »

3
Jésus est au milieu de nous,
Son regard s'abaisse sur nous,
Sa douce voix l'entendez-vous ?
« Oh ! je vous aime tous ! » (X 2)
Sa douce voix l'entendez-vous ?
« Oh je vous aime tous ! »

lyricsEn:
1
Tempted and tried,
we're oft made to wonder
Why it should be thus all the daylong;
While there are others living about us,
Never molested, though in the wrong.

2
Farther along we'll know more about it,
Farther along we'll understand why;
Cheer up, my brother,
live in the sunshine,
We'll understand it all by and by.

3
Sometimes I wonder why I must suffer,
Go in the rain, the cold, and the snow,
When there are many living in comfort,
Giving no heed to all I can do.

4
Tempted and tried, how often we question
Why we must suffer year after year,
Being accused by those of our loved ones,
Even though we've walked
in God's holy fear.

5
Often when death has
taken our loved ones,
Leaving our home so lone and so drear,
Then do we wonder why others prosper,
Living so wicked year after year.

6
"Faithful till death," saith our loving Master,
Short is our time to labor and wait;
Then will our toiling seem to be nothing,
When we shall pass the heavenly gate.

7
Soon we will see our dear, loving Savior,
Hear the last trumpet
sound through the sky;
Then we will meet those
gone on before us,
Then we shall know and understand why.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
The first Noel the angel did say
was to certain poor shepherds
in fields as they lay;
in fields where they
lay keeping their sheep,
on a cold winter's night
that was so deep.

2
Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
born is the King of Israel.

3
They looked up and saw a star
shining in the east, beyond them far;
and to the earth it gave great light,
and so it continued both day and night.

4
And by the light of that same star
three Wise Men came from country far;
to seek for a king was their intent,
and to follow the star wherever it went.

5
This star drew nigh to the northwest,
o'er Bethlehem it took its rest;
and there it did both stop and stay,
right over the place where Jesus lay.

6
Then entered in those Wise Men three,
full reverently upon the knee,
and offered there, in his presence,
their gold and myrrh and frankincense.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn: NO TRANSLATION IN THIS LANGUAGE
lyricsFr:
1
Celui qui met en Jésus
Une pleine confiance,
Jamais ne chancelle plus,
Complète est sa délivrance.

2
Par la foi nous marcherons,
Par la foi nous triomphons,
Par la foi mon Rédempteur
Me rendra plus que vainqueur !

3
Dans les jours d'adversité,
Quand tu sens gronder l'orage,
Regarde en sécurité
À Christ et reprends courage !

4
Quand Satan veut te troubler,
Enlever ton espérance,
Ton passé te reprocher,
Que Christ soit ton assurance !

5
Par la foi je marcherai,
En comptant sur ses promesses,
Par Lui je triompherai
En tout temps de mes détresses !

lyricsEn:
1
The mercy of God is an ocean divine,
A boundless and fathomless flood;
Launch out in the deep, cut away the shore line,
And be lost in the fullness of God.

2
Launch out, into the deep,
Oh, let the shoreline go;
Launch out, launch out
in the ocean divine,
Out where the full tides flow.

3
But many, alas! only stand on the shore
And gaze on the ocean so wide;
They never have ventured
its depths to explore,
Or to launch on the fathomless tide.

4
And others just venture
away from the land,
And linger so near to the shore
That the surf and the slime that
beat over the strand
Dash o'er them in floods evermore.

5
Oh, let us launch out on this ocean so broad,
Where floods of salvation e'er flow;
Oh, let us be lost in the mercy of God,
Till the depths of His fullness we know.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
There are people almost everywhere
Whose hearts are all aflame
With the fire that fell at Pentecost,
Which made them all acclaim;
It is burning now within my heart—
All glory to His name!—
And I'm glad that I can say
I'm one of them.

2
One of them (one of them), one of them (one of them),
I am glad that I can say I'm one of them;

3
Though the people may not learned be,
Nor boast of worldly fame,
They have all received their Pentecost,
Through faith in Jesus' name;
And are telling now, both far and wide,
His power is yet the same,
And I'm glad that
I can say I'm one of them.

4
They were gathered in the upper room,
All praying in His name,
They were baptized in the Holy Ghost,
And power for service came;
Now what He did for them that day
He'll do for you the same,
And I'm glad that I can
say I'm one of them.

5
Come, my brother seek this blessing
That will cleanse your heart from sin,
That will start the joy bells ringing
And will keep the soul aflame;
It is burning now within my heart—
All glory to His name!—
And I'm glad that I
can say I'm one of them.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
There is a fountain filled with blood
Drawn from Immanuel's veins;
And sinners, plunged beneath that flood,
Lose all their guilty stains: (2x)
Lose all their guilty stains;
And sinners, plunged beneath that flood,
Lose all their guilty stains.

2
The dying thief rejoiced to see
That fountain in his day;
And there may I, though vile as he,
Wash all my sins away (2x),
Wash all my sins away;
And there may I, though vile as he,
Wash all my sins away.

3
Dear dying Lamb,
Thy precious blood
Shall never lose its power,
Till all the ransomed Church of God
Be saved, to sin no more (3x)
Till all the ransomed Church of God
Be saved to sin no more.

4
Ever since by faith I
saw the stream
Thy flowing wounds supply,
Redeeming love has been my theme,
And shall be till I die (3x)
Redeeming love has been my theme,
And shall be till I die.

5
When this poor lisping,
stammering tongue
Lies silent in the grave,
Then in a nobler, sweeter song
I'll sing Thy power to save: (3x)
then in a nobler, sweeter song
I'll sing Thy power to save.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
There is a song in my heart today,
Something I never had;
Jesus has taken my sins away,
O! say, but I'm glad.

2
O! say, but I'm glad, I'm glad,
O! say, but I'm glad,
Jesus has come and my cup's overrun;
O! say, but I'm glad.

3
Wonderful, marvelous love He brings,
Into a heart that's sad;
Through darkest tunnels
The soul just sings,
O! say, but I'm glad.

4
We have a fellowship rich and sweet,
Tongues can never relate;
Abiding in Him: the soul's Retreat,
O! but say, I'm glad.

5
Won't you come to Him with all your care,
Weary and worn and sad?
You, too, will sing as His love you share,
O! say, but I'm glad.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
There stands a rock on shores of time
That rears to Heaven its head sublime.
That rock is cleft, and they are blest
Who find within this cleft a rest.

2
Some build their hopes
on the ever drifting sand,
Some on their fame,
or their treasure, or their land;
Mine's on a rock
that forever will stand,
Jesus, the Rock of Ages.

3
That rock's a cross, its arms outspread,
Celestial glory bathes its head;
To its firm base my all I bring,
And to the Rock of Ages cling.

4
That rock's a tower, whose lofty height,
Illumed with Heaven's unclouded light,
Open wide its gate beneath the dome
Where saints find rest with Christ at home.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

titleEn: THERE WAS A TIME ON EARTH
titleFr: THERE WAS A TIME ON EARTH
lyricsEn:
1
There was a time on earth,
when in the book of Heaven
An old account was standing
for sins yet unforgiving;
My name was at the top,
and many things below,
I went unto the Keeper,
and settled long ago.

2
Long ago (down on my knees), long
ago (I settled it all),
Yes, the old account was settled long
ago (Hallelujah!);
And the record's clear today, for He
washed my sins away,
When the old account was
settled long ago.

3
The old account was large,
and growing every day,
For I was always sinning,
and never tried to pay;
But when I looked ahead,
and saw such pain and woe,
I said that I would settle, I settled long ago.

4
When in that happy home,
my Savior's home above,
I'll sing redemption's story
and praise Him for His love;
I'll not forget that book,
with pages white as snow,
Because I came and settled,
and settled long ago.

5
And then if you should
live a hundred years below,
Up there you'll not regret it,
you settled long ago.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
There's a call comes ringing o'er the
restless wave,
"Send the light! Send the light!"
There are souls to rescue,
there are souls to save,
Send the light! Send the light!

2
Send the light the blessed gospel light;
Let it shine from shore to shore!
Send the light the blessed gospel light;
Let it shine forevermore!

3
We have heard the Macedonian call today,
"Send the light! Send the light!"
And a golden offering at the cross we lay,
Send the light! Send the light!

4
Let us pray that grace may everywhere
abound, "Send the light! Send the light!"
And a Christ-like spirit
everywhere be found,
Send the light! Send the light!

5
Let us not grow weary in the work of love,
"Send the light! Send the light!"
Let us gather jewels for a crown above,
Send the light! Send the light!
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
There's a land beyond the river,
That we call the sweet forever,
And we only reach that shore by faith's decree;
One by one we'll gain the portals,
There to dwell with the immortals,
When they ring the golden bells for you and me.

2
Don't you hear the bells now ringing?
Don't you hear the angels singing?
'Tis the glory hallelujah Jubilee.
In that far off sweet forever,
Just beyond the shining river,
When they ring the golden bells for you and me.

3
We shall know no sin or sorrow,
In that haven of tomorrow,
When our barque shall sail beyond the silver sea;
We shall only know the blessing
Of our Father's sweet caressing,
When they ring the golden bells for you and me.

4
When our days shall know their number,
And in death we sweetly slumber,
When the King commands the spirit to be free;
Nevermore with anguish laden,
We shall reach that lovely Eden,
When they ring the golden bells for you and me.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
There's a great day coming,
A great day coming,
There's a great day coming by and by;
When the saints and the sinners shall be parted right and left,
Are you ready for that day to come?

2
Are you ready?
Are you ready?
Are you ready for the judgment day?
Are you ready?
Are you ready?
For the judgment day?

3
There's a bright day coming,
A bright day coming,
There's a bright day coming by and by;
But its brightness shall only come to them that love the Lord,
Are you ready for that day to come?

4
There's a sad day coming,
A sad day coming,
There's a sad day coming by and by;
When the sinner shall hear his doom,
"Depart, I know ye not,"
Are you ready for that day to come?
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
There's within my heart a melody;
Jesus whispers sweet and low,
"Fear not, I am with you, peace, be still,"
in all of life's ebb and flow.

2
Jesus, Jesus, Jesus,
sweetest name I know,
fills my every longing,
keeps me singing as I go.

3
All my life was wrecked by sin and strife,
discord filled my heart with pain,
Jesus swept across the broken strings,
stirred the slumbering chords again.

4
Though sometimes He leads through waters deep,
trials fall across the way;
though sometimes the path seems rough and steep,
see His footprints all the way.

5
Feasting on the riches of His grace,
resting 'neath His sheltering wing,
always looking on His smiling face,
that is why I shout and sing.

6
Soon He's coming back to welcome me
far beyond the starry sky;
I shall wing my flight to worlds unknown,
I shall reign with Him on high.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
Though we may not know the moment
when our blessed Lord shall come
To receive us to mansions over there,
Yet we know 'twill not be long
before He takes His loved ones home,
And we're caught up to meet Him in the air.

2
We'll be caught up
to meet Him in the air,
We'll be caught up
His blessedness to share;
Very soon He will come
To take His people home
Caught up to meet Him in the air.

3
There are times when we are called
to wade through waters deep and wide,
And the sorrows of Christ Himself to share;
We remember He has promised
to be ever at our side,
Till we're caught up to meet Him in the air.

4
Then eternal years in glory
with our Savior we will spend;
O we long for that morning bright and fair!
When the days of our sojourning
and our pilgrimage shall end,
We'll be caught up to meet Him in the air.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

titleEn: THEY WERE IN AN UPPER CHAMBER
titleFr: THEY WERE IN AN UPPER CHAMBER
lyricsEn:
1
They were in an upper chamber,
They were all with one accord,
When the Holy Ghost descended
As was promised by the Lord.

2
O Lord, send the power just now,
O Lord, send the power just now;
O Lord, send the power just now
And baptize every one.

3
Yes, the pow'r from Heav'n descended
With the sound of rushing wind;
Tongues of fire came down upon them,
As the Lord said He would send.

4
Yes, this old-time pow'r was given
To our fathers who were true;
This is promised to believers,
And we all may have it too.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
Thou Christ of burning, cleansing flame,
Send the fire, send the fire, send the fire!
Thy blood bought gift today we claim,
Send the fire, send the fire, send the fire!
Look down and see this waiting host,
Give us the promised Holy Ghost;
We want another Pentecost,
Send the fire, send the fire, send the fire!

2
God of Elijah, hear our cry;
Send the fire, send the fire, send the fire!
To make us fit to live or die,
Send the fire, send the fire, send the fire!
To burn up every trace of sin,
To bring the light and glory in,
The revolution now begin,
Send the fire, send the fire, send the fire!

3
'Tis fire we want, for fire we plead,
Send the fire, send the fire, send the fire!
The fire will meet our every need,
Send the fire, send the fire, send the fire!
For strength to ever do the right,
For grace to conquer in the fight,
For power to walk the world in white,
Send the fire, send the fire, send the fire!

4
To make our weak hearts strong and brave,
Send the fire, send the fire, send the fire!
To live a dying world to save,
Send the fire, send the fire, send the fire!
O see us on Thy altar lay
Our lives, our all, this very day;
To crown the offering now we pray,
Send the fire, send the fire, send the fire!
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
Throw out the lifeline
across the dark wave;
There is a brother whom someone should save;
Somebody's brother! Oh, who then will dare
To throw out the lifeline, his peril to share?

2
Throw out the lifeline!
Throw out the lifeline!
Someone is drifting away;
Throw out the lifeline!
Throw out the lifeline!
Someone is sinking today.

3
Throw out the lifeline with hand quick and strong:
Why do you tarry, why linger so long?
See! he is sinking; oh, hasten today
And out with the life boat! Away, then, away!

4
Throw out the lifeline to danger-fraught men,
Sinking in anguish where you've never been;
Winds of temptation and billows of woe
Will soon hurl them out where the dark waters flow.

5
Soon will the season of rescue be o'er,
Soon will they drift to eternity's shore;
Haste, then, my brother, no time for delay,
But throw out the lifeline and save them today.

6
This is the lifeline, oh, tempest-tossed men,
Baffled by waves of temptation and sin;
Wild winds of passion, your strength cannot brave,
But Jesus is mighty, and Jesus can save.

7
Jesus is able! To you who are driving
Farther and farther from God and from Heaven,
Helpless and hopeless, overwhelmed by the wave,
We throw out the lifeline — 'tis, "Jesus can save."

8
This is the lifeline, oh, grasp it today!
See, you are recklessly drifting away;
Voices in warning, shout over the wave,
Oh, grasp the strong lifeline, for Jesus can save.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE
PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
To me the Holy Ghost is given,
An earnest of the joys of Heaven;

Each day he grows still sweeter
than he was the day before.

2
The half cannot be fancied,
this side the golden shore;
O there he'll be still sweeter than he
ever was before.

3

I saw him from afar;
He's fairer than the lily,
brighter than the morning star;
He fills and satisfies my longing spirit o'er
and o'er;
Each day he grows still sweeter
than he was the day before.

4
My heart is sometimes heavy, but he
comes with sweet relief;
He folds me to his bosom when I droop
with blighting grief,
I love the Christ who all
my burdens in his body bore;
Each day he grows still sweeter
than he was the day before.

wilderness, but His command
Gave assurance we were
able to possess the land.

2
We are able to go up and take the country,
And possess the land
from Jordan to the sea;
And, though giants tall
be there our way to hinder,
God will surely give the victory.

3
When the spies brought back the
message, this is what they said:
Against giants and walled cities,
we cannot be led;
But a Caleb and a Joshua said,
They'll be as bread;
We are able to go up, possess the land ahead.

4
When we crossed the river
Jordan, in the land we found:
Wine and oil and milk and honey,
richest fruits abound;
Sparkling fountains, and the
showers come upon the ground;
We are able, Hallelujah!
Let God's praise resound.

5
There's no thirsting for old Egypt,
since we're in this way,
And we care not what the critics
or the ten spies say;
For the land abounds in plenty,
and we're here to stay,
Won't you come and join us, brother, enter
in today?

From the beauty of the hills,

On the river and the rills,

In the rainbow of the spray:
We shall know each other better
When the mists have cleared away.

2
We shall know as we are known,
Never more to walk alone,
In the dawning of the morning
Of that bright and happy day.
We shall know each other better,
When the mists have rolled away.

With a weary, burdened heart;
Oft we toil amid the shadows,
And our fields are far apart;

When we gather in the morning
Where the mists have rolled away.

We shall gather round the throne;
Face to face with those that love us,
We shall know as we are known;
And the song of our redemption
Shall resound thro' endless day,
When the shadows have departed,
And the mists have rolled away.

Never to leave me alone.

Never to leave me alone.

My Savior stands between —

When earthly friends are gone,
He promised never to leave me,
Never to leave me alone.

My cross when heavy to bear,

Earthly joys all flown;

For me they pierced His side,

The crimson, cleansing tide;

Seated upon His throne,
He promised never to leave me,
Never to leave me alone.

lyricsEn:

Oh, why do you tarry so long?
Your Savior is waiting to give you
A place in His sanctified throng.

2
Why not? why not?
Why not come to Him now?
Why not? why not?
Why not come to Him now?

3
What do you hope, dear brother,
To gain by a further delay?
There's no one to save you but Jesus,
There's no other way but His way.

4
Do you not feel, dear brother,
His Spirit now striving within?
Oh, why not accept His salvation,
And throw off your burden of sin?

5
Why do your wait, dear brother?
The harvest is passing away;
Your Savior is longing to bless you,
There are danger and death in delay.

now my raptured soul can only sing
Of Calvary.

Oh, the grace that brought it down to man!
Oh, the mighty gulf that God did span
At Calvary.

PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
To be like Jesus,
To be like Jesus,
All I ask - to be like Him,
All through life's journey

lyricsEn:
1
'Tis heaven,
O hallelujah, yes, 'tis Heav'n,

'tis Heaven there.

lyricsEn:

Whosoever will to the Lord may come,
Whosoever will to the Lord may come,

Jesus (Jesus) Jesus (Jesus)
Heals the broken hearted (3x)
He will set you free.

lyricsEn:
1
We're Saved, Saved to tell others of the Man of Galilee,

Thank you, Lord, for saving my soul,
Thank you, Lord, for making me whole,

Thy great salvation so rich and free,

by His blood for all eternity.

PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

Many homes rearranged,
Since Jesus came into our town.

Fishers of men, fishers of men,

titleEn: COME, LET US ALL UNITE TO SING
titleFr: POUSSONS DES CRIS DE JOIE EN ACCORD
lyricsEn:
1
Come, let us all unite to sing,
God is love,
Let heav'n and earth their praises bring,
God is love,
Let ev'ry soul from sin awake,
let ev'ry heart sweet music make,
and sing with us for Jesus' sake,
for God is love.

2
God is love! God is love!
Come, let us all unite to sing that God is love.

3
O tell to earth's remotest bound,
God is love,
In Christ we have redemption found,
God is love,
His blood has washed our sins away,
his Spirit turned our night to day,
and now we can rejoice to say
that God is love.

4
What though our mortal flesh shall fail,
God is love!
Through Christ we shall o'er death prevail,
God is love!
While endless ages roll along,
we'll triumph with the heav'nly throng,
and this shall be our sweetest song,
that God is love!
lyricsFr:
1
Dieu nous aime.
Terre et ciel, répétez encor :
Dieu nous aime.
Âme lassée, relève-toi !
Jésus t'a sauvé sur la croix.
Crois-le et chante plein de joie.
Dieu nous aime.

Refrain
Dieu nous aime. (bis)
Poussons des cris de joie en accord.
Que Dieu nous aime.

2
Annoncez jusqu'au bout du monde :
Dieu nous aime,
Dites à chacun sans crainte et honte :
Dieu nous aime.
Christ par son sang nous a rachetés,
Lavés de nos iniquités,
De tous nos fers nous a libérés :
Dieu nous aime.

3
Quel sort remplis de joie ici-bas !
Dieu nous aime.
Guidés par son esprit pas à pas.
Dieu nous aime.
Notre soleil et bouclier,
Dieu nous garde de tout côtés,
Toujours nous rend victorieux,
Dieu nous aime.

lyricsEn:
1
Fairest Lord Jesus,
ruler of all nature,
O thou of God and man the Son,
Thee will I cherish,
Thee will I honor,
thou, my soul's glory, joy, and crown.

2
Fair are the meadows,
fairer still the woodlands,
robed in the blooming garb of spring:
Jesus is fairer,
Jesus is purer
who makes the woeful heart to sing.

3
Fair is the sunshine,
fairer still the moonlight,
and all the twinkling starry host:
Jesus shines brighter,
Jesus shines purer
than all the angels heaven can boast.

4
Beautiful Savior!
Lord of all the nations!
Son of God and Son of Man!
Glory and honor,
praise, adoration,
now and forevermore be thine.
lyricsFr: PAS DE TRADUCTION EN CETTE LANGUE

lyricsEn:
1
The Lord's my Shepherd, I'll not want;
He makes me down to lie
In pastures green; He leadeth me
The quiet waters by.

2
My soul He doth restore again,
And me to walk doth make
Within the paths of righteousness,
E'en for His own name's sake.

3
Yea, though I walk in death's dark vale,
Yet will I fear no ill;
For Thou art with me, and Thy rod
And staff me comfort still.

4
My table Thou hast furnished
In presence of my foes;
My head Thou dost with oil anoint,
And my cup overflows.

5
Goodness and mercy all my life
Shall surely follow me,
And in God's house forevermore
My dwelling-place shall be.
lyricsFr:
1
Jésus est mon divin Berger,
Réjouis-toi mon âme.
Seul Il délivre du danger,
Tout en moi le réclame.

2
Non je ne manquerai de rien,
Car ô grâce infinie,
Jésus est l'Ami, le gardien,
En qui je me confie.

3
Jour après jour, Il me conduit
Dans ses verts pâturages.
De son Amour, Il me nourrit
Sous ses divins ombrages.

4
Je ne craindrai donc aucun mal
Quant au bout du voyage.
Il me faudra du sombre val
Franchir le noir passage.

5
Toujours sa grâce et son amour
Me suivront sur la terre.
Mais tout sera dans son séjour
Paix, gloire, Amour, lumière.

titleEn: O THOU BLEEDING LAMB OF GOD
lyricsEn:
1
Suffering on the rugged cross,
Bearing sin and shame for me,
Dying in great agony!

2
Wonderful place of Calvary!
Wonderful place of Calvary,
Where my Saviour died for me,
Wonderful place of Calvary!

3
When with thorns men crowned Thee head
And Thy precious blood they shed;
When they nailed Thee to the tree
Thou didst die for them and me.

4
Only love has field Thy life,
Never evil, hatred, strife,
Loving, serving was Thy aim
To the utmost: death and shame.

5
Jesus, what Thou didst for me
Is a gift, so great and free;
Take my life and let it be
Thy reward for Calvary!
lyricsFr:
1
À la croix pour moi souffrant,
Tu mourus en honte, angoisse,
Prenant au Calvaire ma place.

Refrain
Lieu de grâce Golgotha,
Lieu de grâce Golgotha,
Où mon Sauveur mourut pour moi :
Lieu de grâce Golgotha!

2
Couronné d'épines pour moi,
Ton corps cloué sur le bois,
Je te vois verser ton sang,
Subissant mon châtiment.

3
Quel amour riche, infinie,
Remplissait toute ta vie,
En rançon pour me sauver
Tu viens pour te sacrifier.

4
Jésus, pour ton sacrifice
Prends ma vie et mon sacrifice!
Qu'ils soient pour le Calvaire
Ma grâce et mon salaire.

lyricsEn: NO TRANSLATION IN THIS LANGUAGE
lyricsFr:
1
Ton Sauveur t'appelle aujourd'hui.
Lève-toi. Sors de ta misère,
Il t'aime, il t'aime, il t'aime, viens à lui.

2
Pourquoi ? Pourquoi
Ne viens-tu pas aujourd'hui
Pourquoi ? Pourquoi
Ne veux-tu donc pas de lui ?

3
Viens à Jésus, viens à la croix.

4
L'heure de ton salut s'envole.
Maintenant tu pourrais encor
Saisir Jésus qui seul console.
L'avoir, ce serait ton trésor.

5
Ne sens-tu pas au fond de l'âme
La puissance de l'Esprit-Saint ?
Ne veux-tu pas que de sa flamme
Jésus te vivifie enfin ?

6
Pourquoi refuses-tu, mon frère,
Quand la mort s'approche de toi
Tandis que brille la lumière.

titleEn: JESUS IS TENDERLY CALLING THEE HOME
titleFr: CŒURS FATIGUÉS ET LASSÉS DU PÉCHÉ
lyricsEn:
1
Calling to-day, Calling to-day!
Why from the sunshine of love wilt thou roam,
Farther and farther away?

2
Calling to-day, calling to-day!
Jesus is calling, is tenderly calling.

3
Jesus is calling the weary to rest —
Calling to-day, calling to-day!
Bring Him thy burden and thou shalt be blest:
He will not turn thee away.

4
Jesus is waiting, oh, come to Him now —
Waiting to-day, waiting to-day;
Come thy sin, at His feet lowly bow;
Come and no longer delay!

5
Jesus is pleading; oh list to His voice —
Hear Him to-day, hear Him to-day!
They who believe on His name shall rejoice;
Quickly arise and away!
lyricsFr:
1
Cœurs fatigués et lassés du péché,
Assez souffert! Assez cherché !
Je puis donner la paix et le repos,
Me charger de vos fardeaux.

2
Venez à lui, venez à lui ;
Venez à Jésus,
Venez à Jésus aujourd'hui!

3
Vous tous, pécheurs condamnés par la loi,
Venez à moi ! venez à moi !
Vous recevrez en vos cœurs dès ce jour
Le pardon du Dieu d'amour.

4
Vous souffrez, par le mal asservis,
Soyez par moi tous affranchis,
Oh ! venez tous, travaillés et chargés,
Et vous serez soulagés.

titleEn: HAVE YOU BEEN TO JESUS FOR THE CLEANSING POWER?
titleFr: DIS, SAIS-TU QUE JÉSUS-CHRIST SEUL PURIFI ?
lyricsEn:
1
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Do you fully trust in His grace this hour?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
There's wonderful power in the blood.

2
Are you washed in the blood?
In the soul-cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless?
Are they washed in the blood of the Lamb?

3
Are you walking daily by the Saviour's side?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Do you rest each moment in the Crucified?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

4
When the Bridegroom cometh will your robes be white?
Pure and white in the bloom of the Lamb?
Will your soul be ready for the mansions bright?
And be washed in the blood of the Lamb?
lyricsFr:
1
Es-tu lavé dans le sang de l'Agneau ?
As-tu confiance en sa grâce infinie
Es-tu lavé dans le sang de l'Agneau ?

2
Oh ! veux-tu, oh ! veux-tu
Que son sang coule sur ton cœur ?
Seul il peut ôter du péché la souillure,
De la neige donner la blancheur.

3
Habites-tu chaque jour en sa présence ?
Es-tu lavé dans le sang de l'Agneau ?
Connais-tu de notre Sauveur la puissance ?
Es-tu lavé dans le Sang de l'Agneau ?

4
Tes vêtements sont-ils purs pour sa venue ?
Es-tu lavé dans le sang de l'Agneau ?
Aux cieux ton âme sera-elle reçue ?
Es-tu lavé dans le sang de l'Agneau ?

lyricsEn: NO TRANSLATION IN THIS LANGUAGE
lyricsFr:
1
Qui du mont Golgotha jaillit !
La mort subie par Christ, la vie,
Nous dit : "Tout est accompli" !

2
Oui, je puis croire,
Oui, je veux croire

3
Que Jésus-Christ est mort pour moi !
Sa mort sanglante et triomphante
Me rend libre par la foi.

4
Source de vie : nos maladies
Pour récompense de ses souffrances,
Devant son trône Jésus voit
La sainte église qu'il s'est acquise
Au prix du sang de la croix.

5
Jésus nous en a délivrés !
Je sens renaître dans tout mon être
La vigueur et la santé.

6
Jésus envoie l'Esprit de joie
Dans les cœurs lavés par le sang :
L'Esprit de gloire et de victoire
Sur les rachetés descend !

titleEn: I'VE WANDERED FAR AWAY FROM GOD
lyricsEn:
1
I've wandered far away from God,
Now I'm coming home;
The paths of sin too long I've trod,
Lord, I'm coming home.

2
CHORUS: Coming home, coming home,
Never more to roam;
The paths of sin too long I've trod,
Lord, I'm coming home.

3
I've wasted many precious years,
Now I'm coming home;
I now repent with bitter tears,
Lord, I'm coming home.

4
I've tired of sin and straying, Lord,
Now I'm coming home;
I'll trust Thy love, believe Thy Word,
Lord, I'm coming home.

5
My soul is sick, my heart is sore,
Now I'm coming home;
My strength renew, my hope restore,
Lord, I'm coming home.
lyricsFr:
1
Je reviens, mon Père.
J'aimais le monde et le péché;
Je reviens, mon Père.

Refrain
Je reviens, je reviens,
Pour ne plus errer,
Je reviens, je reviens,
Je reviens, mon Dieu.

2
J'ai gaspillé de longues années;
Je reviens, mon Père.
Reçois mon cœur contrit, brisé ;
Je reviens, mon Père.

3
Oui, fatigué de mes péchés,
Je reviens, mon Père.
À toi je veux m'abandonner.
Je reviens, mon Père.

4
Le cœur blessé, l'esprit souffrant,
Je reviens, mon Père.
"Pardonne-moi le patient!"
Je reviens, mon Père.

titleEn: I AM SAVED AND I AM FREE
lyricsEn:
1
From the devil's slavery
And with joy I now follow the Lord.
Narrow is the road of life,
Full of suffering, pain and strife,
But my Lord walks with me all the time.

2
CHORUS: Jesus is everything to me,
My joy, my life, my victory.
He changed my life and set me free;
Yes, He is everything to me.

3
I am saved and I am free, this I know.
My surety is God's Spirit that dwells in my heart.
If the tempter tempts with doubt,
Conqu'ring him in faith I'll shout,

4
I am saved and I am free;
Whosoever longs to be
Just like me, Christ is ready for him,
Jesus died to save from hell
Every sinner, you as well;
Only come, give your heart now to Him.

5
I am saved and I am free,
Guarded for eternity;
Nothing ever can turn me from God,
Strong and mighty is the foe,
But whatever He may do,
Christ confounded His works on the cross.
lyricsFr:
1
Du fardeau de mes péchés
Maintenant je suis fort et heureux,
Marchant avec l'Éternel,
Parmi ceux qui vont au ciel,
Vers la sainte demeure de Dieu.

2
CHŒUR : Oui, d'être jeune, c'est merveilleux ;
C'est mieux encor d'être sauvé ;
Pourtant, voici le mieux de tout :
Jeune et sauvé de tous péchés.

3
Je suis jeune et bien content
De servir par le talent
Que la grâce de Dieu m'a donné.
Tous sont appelés de Dieu

4
À mener les malheureux
Vers Jésus le Sauveur des perdus.

5
Je suis jeune et toi aussi ;
Écoute mon chant ici ;
Ne désires-tu pas le bonheur ?
Dieu t'appel à son salut,
Viens reçois-le par Jésus,
Sois heureux comme moi
Dans ton cœur.

titleEn: MORE ABOUT JESUS WOULD I KNOW
lyricsEn:
1
More of His grace to others show;
More of His saving fullness see,
More of His love who died for me.

2
CHORUS: More, more about Jesus;
More, more about Jesus;
More of His saving fullness see,
More of His love who died for me.

3
More about Jesus let me learn,
More of His holy will discern;
Spirit of God, my teacher be,
Showing the things of Christ to me.

4
More about Jesus; in His Word
Holding communion with my Lord,
Hearing his voice in every line,
Making each faithful saying mine.

5
More about Jesus; on His throne,
Riches in glory all His own;
More of His kingdoms sure increase;
More of His coming — Prince of Peace.
lyricsFr:
1
Davantage dans toute ma vie !
Davantage de son salut,
Davantage de son esprit !

2
CHŒUR : Oui, davantage de Christ !
Oui, davantage de Christ !
Davantage de son salut,
Davantage de son Esprit !

3
Davantage enseigne-moi,
Parole sainte, sur ses voies !
Fais-montrer sa sainteté
Et discerne sa volonté !

4
Davantage dans la prière
J'aime connaître le mystère
D'une union parfaite, constante
Et d'une vie toujours triomphante.

5
Davantage de Christ encore
Quand j'entre dans la cité d'or !
Quelle richesse, quel héritage
Seront à jamais mon partage !

titleEn: THERE A CALL COMES RINGING O'ER THE RESTLESS WAVES
titleFr: ENTENDS-TU LE CRI SUR LA MER RUGISSANTE ?
lyricsEn:
1
"Send the light, send the light!"
There are souls to rescue,
There are souls to save,
"Send the light, send the light!"

2
CHORUS: Oh, send the light,
The blessed Gospel light!
Let it shine from shore to shore!
Send the light, the blessed Gospel light!
Let it shine forevermore!

3
We have heard the Macedonian call to-day,
"Send the light, send the light!"
And our grateful off'rings,
At the cross we lay.
"Send the light, send the light!"

4
May the grace of Jesus on to all abound,
"Send the light, send the light!"
And a Christ-like spirit
Ev'ry where be found,
"Send the light, send the light!"

5
Let us not grow weary
In the work of love,
"Send the light, send the light!"
While we gather jewels
For our crown above,
"Send the light, send the light!"
lyricsFr:
1
"Fais briller le port le feu !"
Aux pécheurs perdus
Annonçons le salut !
Fait briller du port le feu !

2
CHŒUR : Fais briller à tous le feu :
Le message du salut.
Fais briller à tous le feu
Pour sauver les naufragés !

3
Entends-tu l'appel Macédonéen ce jour ?
"Fais briller du port le feu !"
"Me voici, Seigneur !" réponds-tu à ton tour?
Fais briller du port le feu !

4
Que la grâce de Christ atteigne le monde
Fais briller du port le feu !
Son Esprit donne la charité profonde,
Fais briller du port le feu !

5
Ne nous fatiguons pas dans ce grand service !
Fais briller du port le feu !
De sauver les naufragés soit la devise.
Fais briller du port le feu !

titleEn: WORK, FOR THE NIGHT IS COMING!
lyricsFr:
1
Dès que l'aube dépose
Ses perles sur les fleurs,
Dès que s'ouvre la rose
Aux brillantes couleurs,
Dès que l'ombre s'efface
Devant le jour qui luit,
À l'œuvre, le temps passe !
À l'œuvre avant la nuit !

2
Quand le soleil inonde
Et remplit le ciel bleu,
Illuminant le monde
De ses rayons de feu,
À l'œuvre sans relâche,
À l'œuvre, le jour fuit !
Si pénible est la tâche,
Bientôt viendra la nuit !

3
À cette heure indécise,
Où le jour disparaît,
Où murmure la brise
À travers la forêt,
Quand le couchant se dore
Et que s'éteint le bruit,
Frère à l'œuvre encore,
Voici, voici la nuit !

titleEn: BANNERS OF VIC'TRY SHALL GO BEFORE US
lyricsEn:
1
To lea our way through the night,
Jesus is with us,
Fighting at our side,
Revealing His power and might.

2
CHORUS: Jesus, our Lord,
To Thee we give honour and glory!
Jesus, our Lord,
To Thee we give all our life.

3
Take up the weapons!
The Spirit upon us,
We shall conquer Satan's domain.
Bravely go onward,
Fight with your whole heart,
Soon will Satan's army be slain.

4
Jesus is with us,
Never He fails us,
Remain true in suff'ring and pain,
Him we shall follow,
Never forsake Him,
Till surely as a King He will reign.
lyricsFr:
1
Dans la sainte guerre !
Suivons l'étendard de la croix !
Luttons sans crainte !
Notre Chef demeure
Avec nous dans chaque combat.

2
CHŒUR : Christ notre Roi,
À toi nous rendons la gloire :
Christ notre Roi,
À toi appartient notre vie.

3
Prenons les armes !
L'Esprit nous fortifie,
Nous fait triompher sur Satan.
"Toujours en avant !
Jamais en arrière !"
Voilà la devise des vaillants.

4
Christ nous dirige,
Jamais ne nous délaisse,
Même dans le plus fort combat.
Donc, nous le suivons,
L'étendard ne se baisse,
Bientôt il sera Roi des rois.

titleEn: IN THY NAME, OH BLESSED SAVIOUR
titleFr: EN TON NOM, SAUVEUR DE GRÂCE
lyricsEn:
1
Gathered in this sacred place;
Here we seek a Father's blessing,
Plead and pray for needed grace;
From the ocean of Thy fullness,
Boundless, fathomless and free,
Let a tidal wave come sweeping,
Setting hearts at liberty.

2
CHORUS: Lift the flood-gates,
Lift the flood-gates,
Let the tide sweeping in;
Blessed tide of full salvation,
Washing, cleansing, from all sin.

3
Lift the flood-gates, let salvation
In tremendous currents flow,
To the uttermost fulfilling
Thy blest mission here below;
Until myriads of sinners
Born on love's resistless tide,
Shall be swept into the kingdom,
And believers sanctified.

4
It is coming, we believe it,
Thou dost hear and answer prayer;
It is coming, we shall see it,
Thine almighty arm made bare;
Tides of power, tides of glory,
Holy tides of perfect love,
Satisfying, overflowing,
Coming on us from above.
lyricsFr:
1
Rassemblés en ce saint lieu,
Nous cherchons ta sainte face,
Demandant tes dons, bon Dieu.
De ta plénitude immense,
Envois-nous un grand réveil,
Des torrents de délivrance
Du péché et du sommeil.

2
CHŒUR : Que les portes des écluses
Montent, nous prions, Seigneur ;
Que l'Esprit nous tous inonde
Et nous rend plus que vainqueurs.

3
Que les portes des écluses
S'ouvrent et ton grand salut
Se répande sur l'Église,
L'inondant en ton Esprit ;
Que les morts et infidèles
Se lèvent à ton appel,
Recevant la vie nouvelle
Par s'offrant sur ton autel.

4
Nous croyons, bientôt il viendra,
Le réveil que tu promis,
À nos cris tu nous répondras
Par la pluie de ton Esprit.
Ta gloire, ta puissance
En torrents vaste, infinis
Se répandront en clémence,
Nous donnant ta sainte vie.

lyricsEn: NO TRANSLATION IN THIS LANGUAGE
lyricsFr:
1
Ils étaient en même accord
Quand l'Esprit de Pentecôte
Descendit comme un vent fort.

2
Seigneur, remplis-nous
De ton Esprit (ter)
Baptise et sanctifie !

3
Cette divine puissance
Remplissait tous les cent-vingt,
Les rendit pleins de confiance
Et pour Christ de vrais témoins.

4
Oui, la promesse du Père
Fut remplie quand l'Esprit.
Et en nos jours, sœurs et frères,
Dieu nous l'accorde aussi.

lyricsEn:
1
Joyful and triumphant,
O come ye, o come ye to Bethlehem!
Come and behold Him,
Born the king of angels!

2
CHORUS: O come, let us adore Him!
O come, let us adore Him!
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ, the Lord!

3
Sing, choirs of angels,
sing in exultation!
O sing, all ye bright hosts
of heav'n above.
Glory to God,
all glory in the highest.

4
Yea, Lord, we greet Thee,
Born this happy morning;
O Jesus, to Thee be all glory giv'n.
Word of the Father,
Now in flesh appearing.
lyricsFr:
1
Jésus vous appelle,
Venez triomphants, joyeux,
Venez en ces lieux !
O peuple fidèle,
Venez voir le Roi des cieux.

2
CHŒUR : Que votre amour l'implore,
Que votre foi l'adore
Et qu'elle chante encore
Ce don précieux ! (verset 1)
Sa gloire en ce jour ! (verset 2)
Son règne sans fin ! (verset 3)

3
Quoi ! dans l'humble étable,
Froide et misérable,
Des bergers le grand amour
Lui forme une cour !
Dans cette humble étable
Accourez à votre tour.

4
C'est le Roi des anges,
Captifs dans les langes,
Splendeur pure et sans déclin
Du Père divin.
C'est le Roi des anges,
Voilé sous un corps humain.

lyricsEn:
1
All is calm, all is bright,
Round the virgin mother and child,
Holy infant, so tender and mild,
Sleep in heavenly peace,
Sleep in heavenly peace!

2
Silent night! Holy night!
Shepherds quake at the sight,
Glories stream from heaven afar,
Heav'nly hosts sing Allelujah,
Christ the Saviour is born!
Christ the Saviour is born!

3
Silent night! Holy night!
Son of God, love's pure light,
Radiant beams from Thy holy face,
With the dawn of redeeming grace,
Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth!
Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth!
lyricsFr:
1
L'étoile est là qui nous conduit,
Allons tous avec les mages,
Porter à Jésus nos hommages,
Car l'enfant nous est né,
Le Fils nous est donné !

2
Voici noël oh ! quel beau jour !
Jésus est né ! quel grand amour !
C'est pour nous qu'il vient sur la terre,
Qu'il prend sur lui notre misère,
Un Sauveur nous est né,
Le Fils nous est donné !

3
Voici Noël ! ah ! d'un seul cœur
Joignons nos voix au divin chœur
Qui proclame au ciel les louanges
De celui qu'annoncent les anges !
Oui, l'enfant nous est né,
Le Fils nous est donné !

titleEn: O FOR A THOUSAND TONGUES TO SING
lyricsEn:
1
My great redeemer's praise, (2x)
The glories of my God and King,
The triumph of,
The triumph of His grace. (3x)

2
Jesus! The name that charms our fear,
That bids our sorrows cease, (2x)
'Tis music in the sinner's ears,
'Tis life and health,
'Tis life and health and peace. (3x)

3
He breaks the power of canceled sin,
He sets the prisoner free; (2x)
His blood can make the foulest clean;
His blood availed,
His blood availed for me. (3x)

4
Hear Him ye deaf; His praise, ye dumb,
Your loosened tongues employ; (2x)
Ye blind, behold your Saviour come;
And leap, ye lame,
And leap, ye lame, for joy. (3x)
lyricsFr:
1
Pour chanter tes louanges, (bis)
Et faire monter jusqu'aux anges
Les gloires de ta croix ! (ter)

2
Jésus, mon Seigneur et mon Dieu,
Que ton souffle m'anime (bis)
Pour que par moi ton nom sublime
Retentisse en tout lieu ! (ter)

3
Doux nom qui fait tarir nos pleurs,
Ineffable harmonie, (bis)
Tu répands la joie et la vie
Et la paix dans nos cœurs ! (bis)

4
Désormais, je n'ai plus d'effroi,
Aucun mal ne m'accable, (bis)
Ton sang rend pur le plus coupable,
Ton sang coula pour moi. (ter)

titleEn: GOD SENT HIS SON, THEY CALLED HIM JESUS
titleFr: LE FILS DE DIEU, LE SEIGNEUR JÉSUS
lyricsEn:
1
He came to love, heal and forgive;
He lived and died to buy my pardon,
An empty grave is there to prove
My Saviour lives.

2
CHORUS: Because He lives I can face tomorrow,
Because He lives all fear is gone;
Because I know He holds the future,
And life is worth the living just because He lives.

3
How sweet to hold a new-born baby,
And feel the pride and joy He gives;
But greater still the calm assurance,
This child can face uncertain days
because He lives.

4
And then one day I'll cross the river,
I'll fight life's final war with pain;
And then as death gives way to vict'ry,
I'll see the lights of glory and I'll know He live.
lyricsFr:
1
Pour racheter un monde perdu,
Donna sa vie sur le Calvaire,
Et de la mort et du tombeau
Il est vainqueur.

REFRAIN :
Parce qu'il vit
Je n'es rien à craindre,
Mes lendemains sont assurés.
Entre ses mains,
Il tien ma vie,
Pour ce temps et l'éternité
Je sais qu'il vit.

2
Ce jour béni, ce beau message
Et l'entendis dans ma misère,
Et j'acceptai le Seigneur Jésus
Et avec lui, je vivrai
Pour l'éternité.

lyricsEn:
1
Jesus, God's own Son;
Precious Lamb of God, Messiah,
Holy One.

2
CHORUS: Thank you, oh, my Father,
For giving us Your own Son,
And leaving your Spirit
Till the work on earth is done.

3
Jesus, my redeemer,
Name above all names;
Precious Lamb of God, Messiah,
O for sinners slain.

4
When I stand in glory,
I will see His face,
There I'll serve my King forever
In that holy place.
lyricsFr:
1
Jésus-Christ, Fils de Dieu,
Ta joie et ta paix m'inondent,
Toi, l'agneau venu des cieux.

2
REFRAIN : Merci notre Père,
D'avoir donné Jésus, ton fils,
Et d'envoyé ta lumière
Par le Saint-Esprit.

3
Rédempteur du monde,
Pour nous, tu fus crucifié,
Ton amour, ta grâce abondent,
O glorieux ressuscité.

4
Un jour, dans la gloire,
Je verrai ta face,
Je vivrai sous ton regard,
Sauvé par ta grâce.

lyricsEn: NO TRANSLATION IN THIS LANGUAGE
lyricsFr:
1
Ne t'inquiète pas,
Mais attends l'arrivée,
Glorieuse de l'Éternel notre DIEU (x2)

2
Il est sur le trône, il observe ta vie,
continue mon frère à observer ses voies.
Mets ton temps à l'œuvre,
Réserve ton huile.
Il ne tarde pas, bientôt il reviendra.

3
Ne t'inquiète pas,
Mais attends l'arrivée,
Glorieuse de l'Éternel notre DIEU (x2)

4
Il est fidèle et digne dans toutes ses voies,
Il tient ses promesses,
Accomplit ce qu'il dit.
À la droite du père il intercède pour toi,
Ne te relâche pas, il revient bientôt (x2)

5
Ne t'inquiète pas,
Mais attends l'arrivée,
Glorieuse de l'Éternel notre DIEU (x2)

lyricsEn: NO TRANSLATION IN THIS LANGUAGE
lyricsFr:
1
Prie et tu recevras,
mais n'abandonne pas !
Christ répondra, si tu attends un peu.
Si ta prière est pure,
alors ta cause est sûre.
Il exaucera ainsi tes vœux.

2
Il ouvrira pour toi. (bis)
La porte, il ouvrira pour toi.
Oui, il l'ouvrira pour toi.

3
Pourquoi être abattu,
pourquoi t'inquiètes-tu ?
Son amitié pour toi est toujours vraie.
Lève tes mains, ami,
sois rempli de l'Esprit !
Comme l'océan sera ta paix.

4
De Dieu être héritier,
de Christ cohéritier !
O quel merveilleux appel, cher ami !
N'es-tu pas dans la joie ?
L'héritage est pour toi !
C'est par la foi que tu le saisis.

5
"Abba, Père !" tu dis,
du péché affranchi,
L'esprit de servitude a disparu.
Chante de tout ton cœur
ta joie, et ton bonheur
D'avoir toutes tes chaînes rompues !

lyricsEn:
1
You unravel me with a melody,
You surround me with a song
Of deliverance from my enemies,
'Til all my fears are gone.

2
I'm no longer a slave to fear,
I am a child of God,
I'm no longer a slave to fear,
I am a child of God.

3
From my mother's womb
You have chosen me,
Love has called my name,
I've been born again to a family,
Your blood flows through my veins.

4
You split the sea
So I could walk right through it,
My fears are drowned in perfect love,
You rescued me, And I will stand and sing,
I am a child of God.
lyricsFr:
1
Tu m'as ébloui par tes mélodies,
Tu m'entoures d'un chant d'amour,
Chant de délivrance devant mes ennemis,
Toutes mes craintes s'enfuient.

Refrain
Je ne suis plus esclave de la peur,
Je suis enfant de Dieu,
Je ne suis plus esclave de la peur,
Je suis enfant de Dieu.

2
Avant ma naissance, tu m'avais choisi,
Appelé par mon nom, tu m'as adopté,
Je suis de ta famille,
Ton sang coule dans mes veines.

3
Tu fends la mer et je peux la traverser,
Mes peurs se noient dans ton amour,
Tu m'as sauvé, alors je peux chanter :
Je suis enfant de Dieu.

lyricsEn: NO TRANSLATION IN THIS LANGUAGE
lyricsFr:
1
C'est pour la liberté
Que Jésus nous a affranchi,
Ne nous mettons plus
Sous le joug de la servitude,
Le monde passe et sa convoitise aussi,
Mais Jésus-Christ demeure éternellement.

2
Dans les cieux sur la terre
Nul n'est semblable à lui,
Il donne la vie, il donne la paix,
Il donne la joie,
Il est la force, il est l'espoir,
Il est le bonheur.

3
Quelle est cette chose
Dont tu as toujours désirée,
Que le monde même les frères
Ne peuvent te l'offrir,
Jésus est le chemin, la vérité et la vie,
La solution à tous tes problèmes.
Quelles sont toutes tes difficultés,
Quels sont donc tous tes soucis,
Quelles sont donc toutes tes incapacités,
À la croix il a tout payé.

4
Quels sont donc tous tes désirs, ami(e)(s),
Quelles sont donc toutes tes inquiétudes,
Quelles sont donc tous tes peines et douleurs,

5
Jésus donne la vie ALLÉLUIA,
Jésus donne la paix ALLÉLUIA,
Jésus-Christ satisfait ALLÉLUIA.

6
Il peut te délivrer, alléluia,
Te guérir, te fortifier, alléluia,
Te bénir et te transformer, alléluia.

7
Tout le monde debout,
Acclamons Jésus, acclamons le Roi,
Élève ta voix, pousse des cris de joie,
Il est merveilleux, il est excellent,
Jésus notre Roi.

titleEn: MY HEART IS FULL OF JOY
lyricsEn:
1
My heart is full of joy and gladness,
Longing for You, my Redeemer!
Give heed to me Lord in Your goodness,
For I am a wretched sinner,
You alone Lord, are my happiness
And I'll trust in You forever.

2
On the way to heaven I'm gladly
Following Your footsteps my King.
When I am tired, You strengthen me,
When I am down, You make me sing;
And in danger, You hold me firmly,
For You are caring and loving.

3
Your light, Lord, is before me by day,
And I find rest in You by night.
In the morning You show me the way,
And you lead me by Your great might.
And as I kneel before You to pray,
You give me vict'ry in the fight.

4
I will soon leave this earth by Your grace,
For you've promised to take me home,
I look forward to seeing Your face,
To receiving a warm welcome,
And I am sure I will win the race,
If the grave shuts itself on me.
lyricsFr:
1
Mon cœur joyeux, plein d'espérance,
S'élève à Toi, mon Rédempteur!
Daigne écouter avec clémence,
Un pauvre humain, faible et pécheur.
En Toi seul est ma confiance,
En Toi seul est tout mon bonheur.

2
C'est vers Ton ciel que, dans ma course,
Je vois aboutir tous mes pas;
De Ton Esprit la vive source
Me rafraîchit quand je suis las;
Et, dans le danger, ma ressource
Est dans la force de Ton bras.

3
Le jour, je marche à Ta lumière;
La nuit, je repose en Ton sein;
Dès le matin, à ma prière,
Tu viens éclairer mon chemin,
Et chaque soir, ô mon bon Père,
Tu prépares mon lendemain.

4
Je vois ainsi venir le terme
De mon voyage en ces bas lieux,
Et j'ai l'attente vive et ferme
Du saint héritage des cieux;
Sur moi, si la tombe se ferme,
J'en sortirai victorieux.

lyricsEn: NO TRANSLATION IN THIS LANGUAGE
lyricsFr:
1
Tiens-moi
Tiens-moi
Jusqu'au bout je veux aller
Achever la course en vainqueur.

2
Mon désir : c'est de courir
Pas comme battant de l'air.
Mais, d'aller chaque jour
En gagnant des points.
Devenir l'hérault que toi tu désir..
oh oui, Seigneur je prie.

3
Mon soupir : c'est qu'en pensant
À la gloire avenir,
Qu'elle illumine mes chemins obscurs,
Que je parvienne à cette stature parfaite
Que toi tu désires..
Seigneur je prie.

4
Fixant les yeux sur le prix qui est devant,
Que chaque jour les vaines envies
s'éloignent de moi,
Qu'elles tombent comme des écailles,
Que le voile se déchire,
Et que je voie ta gloire,
Qu'elle façonne ma foi,
Seigneur je prie.

titleEn: DANS LES CIEUX ET SUR LA TERRE
titleFr: DANS LES CIEUX ET SUR LA TERRE
lyricsEn: NO TRANSLATION IN THIS LANGUAGE
lyricsFr:
1
Dans les cieux et sur la terre,
Il n'est aucun nom plus doux,
Aucun que mon cœur préfère
Au nom de Christ mort pour nous.

2
Quel beau nom ! quel beau nom porte
l'Oint de l'Éternel !
Quel beau nom ! quel beau nom, que
celui d'Emmanuel !

3
Quelque grand que soit un homme,
Qu'il soit prince ou qu'il soit roi,
De quelque nom qu'on le nomme,
Jésus est plus grand pour moi.

4
Les séraphins, les archanges,
Portent des noms glorieux,
Mais le plus beau nom des anges
Pourrait-il me rendre heureux ?

5
Dans les maux, Jésus soulage,
Il guérit l'esprit froissé,
Il ranime le courage
Du cœur le plus oppressé.

6
De quelle joie il inonde
Le cœur du pauvre pécheur !
Non, il n'est rien dans le monde
De pareil à ce bonheur.

lyricsEn: NO TRANSLATION IN THIS LANGUAGE
lyricsFr:
1
Moi, j'ai choisi de suivre Christ et c'est pour la vie,
Rien ici bas ne peut m'arracher de ses bras d'amour,
Quand je regarde à ce qui me fascinait auparavant,
Ce n'est que de la boue.
Moi, je suis radical, radical à suivre Jésus.

2
J'ai pris une décision : Radicale,
Radicale, à suivre Jésus! (Bis)

3
Le royaume de Dieu (je propose ici : la course chrétienne)
C'est pas toujours le lait, le miel
C'est aussi les pleurs, l'épreuve et même les tentations,
Toujours est-il avec Jésus je sais que moi je peux y arriver ehh!
Je suis radical, radical à suivre Jésus.

4
Qu'est-ce qui peut m'arracher de ses bras d'amour, est-ce le manque d'argent?
Non non non!!!

5
Qu'est-ce qui peut m'arracher de ses bras d'amour, est-ce la famine?
Non non non!!!

6
Qu'est-ce qui peut m'arracher de ses bras d'amour, est-ce les persécutions?
Non non non!!!

7
Qu'est-ce qui peut m'arracher de ses bras d'amour, est-ce le rejet?
Non non non!!!

8
Qu'est-ce qui peut m'arracher de ses bras d'amour, est-ce le regard d'un garçon?
Non non non!!!

9
Qu'est-ce qui peut m'arracher de ses bras d'amour, est-ce son silence?
Non non non!!!

10
Je suis Radicale

11
Radicale, je suis radicale,
Radicale, rien ne pourra m'ébranler,
Radicale, je suis radicale,
Radicale, par sa grâce, j'y arriverai,
Radicale, je suis radicale,
Radicale, ma décision est prise,
Radicale, je suis radicale,
Radicale, ma décision est ferme!!!...
RADICALE!!!

titleEn: I AM THE GOD THAT HEALETH THEE
titleFr: I AM THE GOD THAT HEALETH THEE
lyricsEn:
1
I am the God that
Healeth thee,
I am the Lord
Your healer.
I sent My word
And I healed your disease,
I am the Lord
Your healer.

2
You are the God that
Healeth me,
You are the Lord
My healer.

3
You sent Your word
And You healed my disease,
You are the Lord
My healer.

4
You sent Your word
And You healed
My disease,
You are the Lord
My healer. (x2)
